mentions.name: Approximated
mentions.description: Managed service that makes connecting user custom domains to an app easy and reliable at any scale. Each user gets a globally distributed, managed cluster of servers with a dedicated IPv4 address, and features include unlimited edge rules, DDoS protection, webhooks, and automatic SSL certificates. Integration is via a simple API call plus having the user point an A record at the provided IP.
mentions.problem: Connecting user domains to an app with SSL and reliability at scale is difficult to handle on your own.
mentions.audience: Developers building apps (such as SaaS products) that need to support user custom domains
mentions.source_excerpt: It makes connecting user domains to your app easy and reliable at any scale. Make a simple API call, tell the user to point an A record at the IP, and it’s connected to your app with its own SSL certificates.
